{{Quote|However, if Rebel agents are ever caught in the sector, Colonel Jev will be the one to notify the Alliance of their location. Jev has provided covert assistance to Rebel units operating in the sector, but never becomes directly involved.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The '''Wyloff sector''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the astronomical objects [[Nieuth Four]], [[Wyloff]], and [[Wynth]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Wyloff [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Varnier]], illegally used [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents to carry out [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] of potential threats to his rule over the sector.

Varnier once ordered the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of a prominent [[Ilo Jev's father|local broadcast personality]] of Wyloff who had publicly criticized the Moff's rule. [[Ilo Jev/Legends|Ilo Jev]], the [[Gender/Legends|son]] of the executed man, had by that [[Time/Legends|time]] become the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Wyloff sector Imperial Intelligence ExComm facility]] and eventually helped expose Varnier's illegal activities. As a result, Jev became a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|in charge]] of the [[External Communications|ExComm]] facility but harbored deep hatred for the Empire's leadership. After a meeting with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] on Nieuth Four, Jev began covertly assisting the Alliance and supplying it with strategic information from his facility.

==Description==
{{Quote|I met with Colonel Jev on Nieuth Four.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The Wyloff [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the [[Nieuth system/Legends|Nieuth]], [[Wyloff system/Legends|Wyloff]], and [[Wynth system/Legends|Wynth systems]]. The Wynth [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained<ref name="EAOC" /> the astronomical object of the [[Wynth|same name]],<ref name="CRO" /> and the Nieuth and Wyloff systems contained<ref name="EAOC" /> the terrestrial celestial bodies [[Nieuth Four]] and [[Wyloff]], respectively.<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
===Ilo Jev's origins===
Wyloff was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ilo Jev/Legends|Ilo Jev]], who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] approximately [[36 BBY/Legends|thirty-six years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Jev eventually became an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] within the [[Wyloff Sector Plexus]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Wyloff sector was governed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Varnier]], who illegally ordered agents of the [[Destabilization]] and [[Assassination (Imperial Intelligence)|Assassination]] branches of Imperial Intelligence to carry out a series of [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] against anyone who posed a threat to Varnier's absolute rule over his sector.<ref name="CRO" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after Jev was transferred to the [[External Communications]] section of Imperial Intelligence, Varnier ordered the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of [[Ilo Jev's father|Jev's father]], a prominent local broadcast personality on Wyloff who had publicly noted the Moff's preoccupation with recreational pursuits instead of government matters. Jev was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] at the [[Wyloff sector Imperial Intelligence ExComm facility]] the same [[Standard day/Legends|day]] his [[Parent/Legends|father]] was killed. Thanks to the secret involvement of the Destabilization agent [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kerri Lessev/Legends|Kerri Lessev]], Jev soon discovered Varnier's use of Intelligence assets for advancing his own personal agenda and put into motion events that led to the exposure and elimination of the Moff as well as the weeding out of inefficiencies in Wyloff command.<ref name="CRO" />

===Rebels in the Wyloff sector===
{{Quote|Colonel Jev is in no immediate danger of discovery in the Wyloff system&mdash;he's that deeply entrenched.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives|<ref name="CRO" />}}
[[File:Northal.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Imperial defector and Rebel Alliance operative Vin Northal was stationed in the Wyloff sector.]]
Those events led to Jev himself being promoted to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|in charge]] of the Wyloff sector ExComm facility, and the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] equipment included a [[Code cylinder/Legends|rank cylinder code key]] that granted him access to the entire Imperial [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and communications network of the Wyloff sector. Under Jev's command, the Wyloff facility became the most efficient of all the local sectors. However, partly due to his [[Gender/Legends|father's]] death, Jev harbored a deep hatred for the Empire and its corrupt and power-hungry leaders.<ref name="CRO" />

By the time the Battle of Yavin was fought, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]] and Imperial defector Colonel [[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]] contacted Jev, who was on leave at the time. Through Northal, a meeting was arranged between Jev and Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. As a result of the meeting, which took place on Nieuth Four, Jev began to provide the Alliance with strategic information from his ExComm facility, including the location of any Rebel agents captured in the Wyloff sector. Jev additionally provided any Alliance units operating within the sector with covert assistance. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Northal, who had facilitated Jev's defection, was stationed at the Wyloff sector astronomical object Wynth. Around that time, Cracken noted Jev's activities in the sector in personal addendums to a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing Rebel operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wyloff sector was created by [[David R. Tulo, Jr.]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the sector was depicted visually in an illustration of the Wyloff sector Imperial Intelligence ExComm facility by [[Doug Shuler]].<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Wyloff sector's Nieuth, Wyloff, and Wynth systems in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />
